name: Front Squat
setup: Shoulder-harness variation: use a fitted harness and start light.
Set both shoulder pads and bar catches before lifting from a rack.
Keep feet planted; brace before each squat.

advice.tip: Keep the harness supported on both shoulders and the bar secure in its catches.
commonMistakes: Letting the harness tip or lose shoulder contact.
Lifting your heels or letting knees collapse inward.
Losing your brace or leaning far forward.

beats.label: Stand
beats.cue: Stand tall; keep the harness supported.

beats.label: Brace
beats.cue: Brace; keep both feet firmly planted.

beats.label: Squat
beats.cue: Bend hips and knees; keep heels grounded.

beats.label: Control
beats.cue: Keep chest lifted and knees tracking outward.

beats.label: Rise
beats.cue: Push through your whole feet to stand.

beats.label: Reset
beats.cue: Stay braced with both hands stabilising.
